name: Presidential Shaman
source:
Through a random encounter with the president, you suddenly became a "reliable" guide to him.

Now, you personally help the president with your powers of future prediction.

With all the wacky choices you make, these will for sure affect the future.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4175380/]Steam[/url]]
